faq_en.q: Are the contact forms GDPR-compliant (tax secrecy)?
faq_en.a: Yes, absolutely. The protection of sensitive data is our highest priority. We rely on encrypted connections, secure hosting in Germany, and integrate highly secure portals (like DATEV or proprietary Nextcloud solutions) for document exchange.

faq_en.q: Can clients upload their receipts via the website?
faq_en.a: For security and process reasons, we recommend the direct integration of DATEV Unternehmen online (or comparable tools). We integrate the login area extremely prominently and user-friendly directly on your website.

faq_en.q: How can we actively find new employees (tax assistants)?
faq_en.a: The shortage of skilled workers in your industry is the biggest obstacle to growth. We build emotional career pages, present your firm as a modern employer (home office, digital files), and simplify the application process (e.g., short mobile applications).

faq_en.q: Can we publish firm news and tax changes ourselves?
faq_en.a: Yes, we integrate a very easy-to-use Headless CMS. You can publish client information, blog posts, or client circulars online at lightning speed and without agency help.

faq_en.q: We no longer want small income tax cases. Does the website help?
faq_en.a: Definitely. We use the website as a filter. Through the tone of voice, premium design, and upstream (automated) query processes, you attract lucrative corporate mandates and elegantly filter out unsuitable inquiries.

faq_en.q: How long does it take for our firm website to be finished?
faq_en.a: Because we know your time is extremely limited, we work very autonomously. After an initial strategy meeting, we completely take over the concept, copy, and design. A relaunch can usually be realized in 4 to 8 weeks.
